name: pstack-vibe
description: pstack for the Mistral Vibe CLI

scripts.test:shell: sh tests/install.test.sh && sh tests/doctor.test.sh && sh tests/session-start.test.sh && sh tests/chain-record.test.sh && sh tests/chain-gate.test.sh && sh tests/remove-tree.test.sh
scripts.lint: shellcheck scripts/*.sh generated/vibe/ai.mistral.vibe/scripts/*.sh && npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 "README.md" "NOTICE.md" "SECURITY.md" "CHANGELOG.md" "docs/**/*.md" && npx --yes github-actionlint
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:shell && npm run check && npm run lint
